# bluestonepim_category_context (Resource)

Sets the name and / or description of a category for a specific context, for example another language or a sales channel. Values that are not set fall back to the fallback context. The category tree itself is the same for every context.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bluestonepim_context" "dutch" {
  name   = "Dutch"
  locale = "nl-NL"
}

resource "bluestonepim_category" "bikes" {
  name        = "Bikes"
  description = "All our bikes"
}

resource "bluestonepim_category_context" "bikes_nl" {
  category_id = bluestonepim_category.bikes.id
  context_id  = bluestonepim_context.dutch.id
  name        = "Fietsen"
  description = "Al onze fietsen"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category_id` (String) The ID of the category.
- `context_id` (String) The ID of the context (see `bluestonepim_context`).

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the category in this context.
- `name` (String) The name of the category in this context.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bluestonepim_category_context.bikes_nl <category_id>/<context_id>
```
